card.name: Inside surnames and short URL codes
card.fires_on: Pieces inside author surnames in reference lists (e.g. Evans, Umenai, Wakai) and inside random characters of shortened links or DOI codes.

modes.label: Author surname endings
modes.description: Final or middle piece of a surname in a citation author list.
modes.example: Okumura J, Wakai S, Umen<<ai>> T. Drug utilisation and self-med

modes.label: Short link or DOI codes
modes.description: Random letters or digits inside a tinyurl link or DOI string.

card.writes: The promoted tokens are code-like fragments, suggesting it pushes toward more identifier-style pieces.
card.plain: It lights up on the middle of names and random codes in reference lists and web links.
